In the south corner of the property where a driver hit the fence, there is still a hole approximately 6 inches by 8 inches,
one to 2 feet off the ground. The perimeter fence must be constructed so that it protects the animals in the facility by
restricting animals and unauthorized persons from going through it or under it and having contact with animals in the
facility, and so that it can function as a secondary containment system for the animals in the facility. A gap of that size can
allow animals in or out and does not protect the animals in the facility by restricting animals from going through it or act as
secondary containment for the animals in the facility. All outdoor housing facilities must be enclosed by a perimeter fence
in order to ensure the welfare of the animals under the Animal Welfare Act.
Correct by 29 June 2026.
